title: Welcome to Samson Blogs
author: Elisha - Founder
content:
Welcome to Samson Blogs — your new go-to corner of the internet for stories that matter, insights that cut through the noise, and reporting with a spark of personality.

We cover news with clarity, context, and just enough wit to remind you that information doesn’t have to be boring. Serious developments? We’ve got them. Strange twists and quirks of the world? We won’t ignore them. Occasional dry humor? Definitely included.

Here, trends don’t dictate what we write — substance does. Each post is designed to inform, provoke thought, and sometimes make you smile while staying fully credible.

Consider this your invitation to explore, engage, and maybe even learn something unexpected along the way. The newsroom is open, the stories are ready, and Samson Blogs is officially live.

title: Neocities Blocked by Bing: What’s Really Happening
author: Elisha - Founder
content:
🧠 What Happened

In late January 2026, the Bing search engine removed the domain neocities.org and all of its subdomains from its search index. That means none of the millions of free websites hosted there appeared in Bing’s search results — and because DuckDuckGo uses Bing’s index, Neocities sites initially disappeared from DDG too.

Neocities creators say they tried for months to resolve this directly with Bing but didn’t get a clear response or a reversal.

Later, DuckDuckGo rolled out an update that restored Neocities listings when you include “neocities” in the search, though descriptions under results may still be missing.

💥 Why It Matters

Neocities hosts over 1.5 million independent sites — everything from personal portfolios and creative experiments to tiny blogs and micro‑communities.

Being excluded from a major search engine has real effects beyond inconvenience:

  • 🧭 Users can’t discover Neocities sites via Bing or Bing‑powered search.

  • 📉 Site traffic drops, especially for creators relying on organic search visits.

  • 📡 Some AI tools and chatbots that pull from Bing index results may also not show those Neocities pages, reducing visibility still further.

For creators without marketing budgets, this means their voices literally vanish from the way most people explore the web. It’s not just blocking a link — it’s dimming the spotlight on entire tiny corners of the internet that thrive on openness and discovery.

📉 Consequences — Real People, Real Sites

The block doesn’t remove Neocities sites from existence — you can still visit them directly — but it changes the ecosystem around them:

  • 🔍 Discovery becomes harder. Newcomers can’t find your site through search.

  • 🎯 Traffic drops sharply, especially for creators who depended on search engine referrals.

  • 📈 SEO efforts become less effective unless creators use custom domains or alternate hosting.

For many folks, it’s a reminder of how fragile independent web visibility can be when distributed through centralized corporate systems.

❤️ Emotional & Cultural Impact

At its core, this is more than a technical glitch — it’s a stark reminder of how much control large platforms have over what we can find on the internet. Neocities has always been about:

  • Freedom to create

  • Playfulness on the web

  • A DIY ethos

  • Non‑commercial space for self‑expression

For people who built their first sites there, or rely on Neocities as a stepping stone into web development, it feels like being cut off from the map of the internet. It’s not just “search traffic down” — it’s the emotional impact of having your space suddenly rendered invisible to the world.

And yet, the community’s response — from talking about alternative search tools, to advocating for fixes — shows how much people care about keeping the indie web alive.

title: Growing Together: The Next Chapter of Samson Recipes
author: Elisha - Founder
content:
Since launching several months ago, Samson Recipes has grown steadily, recently reaching 150,000 total visits. This milestone shows there’s a real community of cooks and food lovers who believe in what we’re building — and I’m excited to take it even further.



What’s Coming Next



Samson Recipes is evolving into a social recipe platform where users will be able to:


  • Create accounts with profiles
  • Post written recipes or recipe videos
  • Like or dislike posts
  • Save recipes to personal meal plans
  • Have exceptional recipes become official Samson Recipes features
  • Participate in monthly “Recipe of the Month” contests, with winners receiving trophies and free merch



This is a space where cooking is social, fun, and rewarding — a place for your recipes, your videos, and your creativity to shine.



Thank You



Reaching 150,000 visits shows how much people enjoy and support Samson Recipes. Every visit and every interaction helps build a stronger community. I can’t wait to see what everyone creates as we move into this next chapter.

title: 🚀 Almost 200k Visits… And Yeah, I’ve Been Quiet
author: Elisha - Founder
content:
So… almost 200,000 visits. Took a while, right? Honestly, I was starting to think the internet had completely forgotten about this little corner of chaos. But nope—you’re still here, and so is the site.


Let’s be real: this didn’t grow because of hype, fanfare, or viral nonsense. It grew because a few stubborn souls kept showing up, probably out of curiosity… or pity. Either way, it counts.



Full Disclosure



Yes, I’ve been absent on the recipe front the last couple of months. Production work has been eating all my time. But don’t worry—recipes are coming back, and soon. More testing, more chaos, more things that actually make sense to cook.



What’s Really Happening



  • Recipes that hit: Follow them, eat, and try not to burn the kitchen down.
  • Content that actually matters: No fluff, no clickbait, no nonsense.
  • Consistency wins: Even when invisible, showing up eventually adds up.




The Big Picture



Almost 200k is cute, but that’s not the goal. Over the next 6–24 months, this site is leveling up into the go-to place for chefs to share their stories, their recipes, and their brutally honest takes on dishes. Classics, experiments, “what even is this?” moments—you name it. Chefs will have a platform, and people will actually see it.


So yes—almost 200k. Slow clap if you want. But hang tight, because the next chapter is where this little project stops being “almost” and starts being impossible to ignore. 🎉


Oh, and whoever tried the Taco Mac & Cheese Bake—I hope you loved it. If not, well… there’s always the next recipe. 😏

title: Samson Recipes 1.28 Release Announcement
author: Elisha - Founder
content:
We’re excited to announce that Samson Recipes 1.28 will release on July 4, 2026, at 5:00 PM EDT!

This update introduces new systems and major improvements to how you browse, organize, and experience recipes across the platform.


🆕 Added

🧱 Grid Layout System

The site has been redesigned with a grid-based layout, replacing the previous list format. This makes browsing recipes faster, cleaner, and more visually structured across all devices.

🏷️ Enhanced Filtering & Tagging

A new filtering and tagging system has been added, making it easier to discover recipes and narrow down results with better precision.

❤️ Favorites & Collections System

A new favorites and collections system has been added, allowing you to save, organize, and revisit your favorite recipes in a more structured way.

⚡ Live Website Updates

Live updates have been added to the website, allowing recipe changes and updates to appear automatically without needing to refresh the page.

🔗 URL State Saving (Search & Filters)

The site now saves your current search and filter state in the URL. This means when you refresh the page or share a link, you return to the same view you were on.


🔧 Improved

🔎 Sorting System

The sorting system has been improved to provide more control and faster ways to organize recipes.


📅 Release Information

  • Version: 1.28
  • Release Date: July 4, 2026
  • Release Time: 5:00 PM EDT


💬 Closing Note

This update focuses on improving the core structure of Samson Recipes and making the platform more dynamic, organized, and user-friendly.

More recipes, features, and expansions are planned for future updates as the platform continues to grow.
